dataset.method: Lag (2004:629) om trängselskatt, bilaga 1: per passage of a charging station, by time of day, inner city or Essingeleden, low or high season; at most 105 SEK a day (135 in high season); weekdays, not the day before a public holiday (except before Good Friday, Ascension, All Saints, and 1 May and National Day on weekdays), in July only its first five weekdays. Foreign-registered vehicles pay too (4 §). Stations: Transportstyrelsen's gantries in OpenStreetMap.

tax.note: carbon-cost states the tax basis in each table's text (dataset.method), not as a field.
